finding.title: OS Command Injection
finding.trigger: If the input contains format specifiers (e.g., %s, %n), it could lead to arbitrary code execution.
finding.assumptions: The attacker can control the input data received from the client, which is then printed using printf.

finding.title: Buffer Overflow
finding.trigger: If the received data is larger than the buffer size, it could lead to a buffer overflow.
finding.assumptions: The attacker can control the input data size, and the buffer is fixed in size.
